purpose: Verified reference-newsletter feeds and selected official sources, supplemented by official Moomoo headline discovery.
enabled_means: Eligible for collection; not a guarantee of current items, full coverage, independent verification or permission to republish full articles.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Board — press releases
sources.coverage_notes: Official policy, supervision and other releases; no consensus estimates or complete economic calendar.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Board — working papers
sources.coverage_notes: Research publication notices and abstracts; relevance to quantitative investing requires selection. An abstract is not a full-paper review or replication.

sources.name: arXiv — quantitative finance
sources.coverage_notes: Quantitative-finance preprints and revisions; not peer-reviewed conclusions, investment recommendations or replicated results.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR — latest 8-K filings
sources.coverage_notes: At most 40 recent filing records upstream, then a bounded selection; not a complete daily filing archive or earnings dataset. Atom updated is the record update time. Respect SEC access limits.

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — latest numbers
sources.coverage_notes: Official release links; statistical period, publication time and revisions require source evidence. No consensus estimates.

sources.name: NVIDIA — news releases
sources.coverage_notes: Company-issued releases, not independent reporting or comprehensive U.S. equity coverage.

sources.name: CNBC — Finance
sources.coverage_notes: Publisher headlines and short RSS descriptions only; no article-body fetch or licensed newswire access.

sources.name: CNBC — Technology
sources.coverage_notes: Publisher headlines and RSS descriptions only; overlapping stories require deduplication.

sources.name: The Wall Street Journal — Markets
sources.coverage_notes: Dow Jones-hosted public headline RSS and available descriptions; linked articles may require a subscription. No paywall access or full text is included.

sources.name: The Wall Street Journal — Business

sources.name: The Wall Street Journal — Technology

sources.name: South China Morning Post — Business

sources.name: DIGITIMES Asia — daily news
sources.coverage_notes: Public semiconductor and technology headlines with short publisher descriptions; no paid full-text access.

sources.name: 雷峰网

sources.name: 爱范儿

sources.name: The Compound and Friends

sources.name: 硅谷101

constraints: Collect only items with usable source dates in the rolling 48-hour window; preserve source date precision and timezone metadata.
Publisher feeds and podcasts are feed_excerpt_only: never fetch article bodies or audio, solve access challenges or bypass paywalls.
Public RSS and HTTP success do not establish full-text republication rights or independently verify source claims.
Deduplicate overlapping feeds and select for macroeconomics, U.S. equities and quantitative research; omit empty sections instead of filling quotas.
Retain links and attribution. No consensus, financial value, event date or transcript may be invented from headline-only material.
Moomoo headline-only items may be selected and categorized, but not expanded into inferred summaries or analysis; original titles and the normal financial-evidence checks are retained.
